metadata.description: Project Sandstar MCP marketplace: Claude Code plugins for the Fantom MCP and Axon MCP servers.

plugins.name: fantom-mcp
plugins.description: Fantom MCP server as a Claude Code plugin: semantic code search, call graph, impact, change history, docs and SkySpark 3.x to 4.0 migration for every registered project. Hooks report edits and inject project context at session start.

plugins.name: axon-mcp
plugins.description: Axon MCP server as a Claude Code plugin: Axon examples, patterns, docs, call graph, semantic search, Haystack queries, and running and committing Axon in the active SkySpark project. Workflow guides ship as skills.
